name: Baanwestriijd
description: Team 151 Hans Anders organizes a track race in Gorinchem on Thursday, September 17, 2026. The race starts at 7:00 PM and offers participants a choice of two distances: 0.8 km and 3 km. The event takes place on an athletics track and is suitable for runners who enjoy a short and intense course.
course_highlights: Short track race on an athletics track
Choice of 0.8 km and 3 km distances
Start time at 7:00 PM in the evening
additional: Participants can choose between short and medium distances; the event takes place on an athletics track in Gorinchem; ideal for runners who want to enjoy a sporty evening.

name: Papendorpse Run
description: The Papendorpse Run is an annual running event for everyone working at Utrecht Businesspark Papendorp, but also open to running enthusiasts from Utrecht. Participants can choose from two courses: a short course of 1.3 km, ideal for beginners and casual runners, and a longer course of 3 km for the seasoned runner looking for a challenge. The event has a social goal: supporting Special Olympics Netherlands, an organization that makes sports accessible for people with intellectual disabilities. The atmosphere is informal and focused on exercising together and having fun, with a friendly drink afterwards at the Steiger.
course_highlights: 1.3 km short course, suitable for beginners
3 km longer course for challenging rounds
Location on the grounds of Utrecht Businesspark Papendorp
additional: Participants can decide how many rounds they run, alone or in teams. A free clinic is available. After running, there is a drink at the Steiger. Companies can become sponsors and provide employees with free access through sponsorship packages starting at €500. Options for individual and team participation, sponsorship packages, free clinics, and facilities such as changing rooms and refreshments.

name: Iedema Building Run 2026
description: The Iedema Building Run 2026 in Harderwijk is a sporting event focused on movement, meeting, and entrepreneurship, with a special emphasis on supporting the Princess Beatrix Muscle Fund. Participants can walk, run, and commit to raising money for research into muscle diseases. The event encourages personal and team actions to make a positive impact for people with muscle diseases. It is an accessible and meaningful run for everyone who wants to contribute to a future without muscle diseases.
additional: The event supports the Princess Beatrix Muscle Fund and encourages participants to start personal sponsorship campaigns, contribute as a team, and raise funds for muscle disease research. Participants are encouraged to fundraise and actively participate in an event that promotes movement and community spirit.

name: Damloop by night 2026
description: The Damloop by night is a unique evening run of 5 miles (8 km) that starts in Amsterdam and finishes in Zaandam. This run is known for its festive atmosphere with great beats and light effects, making it a non-stop party for all participants. The event combines athletic challenge with a lively ambiance, ideal for runners who enjoy a special experience.
course_highlights: Start in Amsterdam, finish in Zaandam
Festive atmosphere with music and light effects
additional: The Damloop by night is a non-stop party with beats and light acts. There is a special registration procedure for fast runners who finished in the top 3 of the previous edition. Additional products such as the official On Running shirt can also be ordered. The organization pays attention to safety and prevention of overheating among runners. The event includes various race distances, virtual options, and a festive closing. The 8 km race is characterized by a celebratory atmosphere and starts and finishes at the Olympic Stadium.

name: Run & Roast Eindhoven
location: Museumpark VONK, Eindhoven, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Eindhoven takes place on Saturday, September 19, and offers participants a choice of a 5 or 10 kilometer running race, as well as a 1 kilometer kids run for primary school children. The course is flat, fast, and well-paved, with start and finish at Museumpark VONK in the renovated Prehistoric Village in the Genneper Parks. After running, participants can enjoy a delicious plant-based burger from Beyond Meat, music, and a friendly atmosphere with food trucks. There are attractive prizes for the fastest runners and special discount offers for participants.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course of 5 or 10 kilometers through Genneper Parks
Start and finish at Museumpark VONK, in the renovated Prehistoric Village
Well-paved route with one or two laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 15:00 at Brasserie Vonk. A plant-based Beyond Meat burger is included with registration. Discount coupons for All4running and Virtuoos nutritional supplements are available for participants. Prize winners will receive items such as Karhu running shoes, Shokz earphones, and supplement packages. There will be music and a friendly atmosphere with food trucks after the finish. Flat course, start and finish at Museumpark VONK, including burger, music, food trucks, and kids run.

description: The 11th edition of the Kwintelooyen Run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, in the beautiful nature reserve of the Utrecht Hill Ridge near Rhenen. This running event offers four distances: a kids run of 1 km, and the 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km routes that are entirely on natural terrain. The run supports charities that work for children and young people with disabilities. Participants receive an exclusive Puma running shirt and a medal at the finish, making the event sporty and festive.
course_highlights: Course entirely on natural terrain: forest paths, sandy trails, single trails, and semi-paved sections
Beautiful climbs and panoramic views of the Utrecht Hill Ridge
Quiet and traffic-free routes without asphalt, cobblestones, or traffic lights
additional: The kids run starts at 11:00 AM, the 5 km at 12:00 PM, the 10 km at 1:30 PM, and the 15 km at 2:00 PM. Participants in the 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km receive an exclusive Puma running shirt when picking up their race number. Every runner gets a medal at the finish. Registration with a discounted rate is open until September 13, after which late registration is possible until September 18 as long as start numbers are available. The event supports two charities: Stichting Netwerk voor Jou and Stichting De Wijde Mantel Q-Dreams. Registration until September 13, 2026, with a discount; late registration possible; medals and sports shirts for participants; location in Rhenen on the Utrecht Hill Ridge.
